messages:
maria (Docs): Quick ask — drafting an onboarding note for SOC2 customers moving from one-off audit downloads to scheduled exports. Need tiny curl + python examples and a short legal-safe sentence about downstream custody. Also include required scopes and a short KMS tip.

asha (Eng): Endpoint: POST /v1/audit/exports (tenant_id, start_ts, end_ts, redact_level, export_ttl_seconds, retention_cutoff_ts, mask_fields[]). Download: GET /v1/audit/exports/{id}/download. Example will use small defaults.

sam (Legal): Keep liability language tight. Suggested one-liner: "Exports are point-in-time snapshots. Customers remain responsible for retention, deletion, and access controls of exported copies; Redwood issues time-limited download links and encrypted delivery but does not assume custody of exported copies." Avoid "guarantee"/"forever".

troy (DevEx): Recommend export_ttl_seconds=1800 in examples and show streaming to file. Add a short note about chunked/page_size downloads for very large tenants.

oliver (Security): Checklist: least-privilege scopes (`audit:read`, `export:create`, optional `kms:decrypt`), rotate keys for scheduled exports, and restrict scheduled export destinations. Encrypted exports may be KMS-wrapped and need client-side unwrap.

maria (Docs): Snippets (trimmed):

```bash
# create export
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","start_ts":1700000000,"end_ts":1700086400,"redact_level":"partial","export_ttl_seconds":1800}'

# download (stream to file)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports/EXPORT_ID/download" --output acme-export.jsonl
```

```python
# python streaming example
import os, requests
url = 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/audit/exports/EXPORT_ID/download'
headers = {'Authorization': f"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_API_KEY')}"}
with requests.get(url, headers=headers, stream=True) as r:
    r.raise_for_status()
    for line in r.iter_lines(decode_unicode=True):
        if line:
            print(line)
```

maria (Docs): I'll land a short migration section in PR #600 with this wording and checklist, then tag legal/security for final sign-off. Thanks!
